pricing_text: Your request will cost **$0.03** for the first megapixel of output, plus **$0.015** per extra megapixel of input and output, rounded up to the nearest megapixel. For example, a **1024x1024** image will cost **$0.03**, and a **1920x1080** image will cost **$0.045** (**$0.03** for first megapixel + **$0.015** for the second megapixel). Similarly, a **512x512** output will cost **$0.03** (**$0.03** for **0.25** megapixels, rounded to **1** megapixel)
notes: $0.03 لأول ميغابكسل من المخرج + $0.015 لكل ميغابكسل إضافي من المدخل والمخرج، مقرّبًا لأعلى لأقرب ميغابكسل. 1024×1024 = $0.03، 1920×1080 = $0.045، 512×512 = $0.03.
